name: Which values overlap, and whether a catch-all is missing

request.userText: Are my values clear? Which ones overlap?

workspace.task: Label the format of short videos

result.note: Mix-ups are counts summed over every scored version, never examples.

reply: Names Vlog and Tutorial as overlapping and quotes the words that overlap ("explains something they do" against "shows how to do something")
Points out there is no catch-all value such as Other for items that fit neither
Does not change the prompt unasked; offers to sharpen the definitions
